name: Tre Geathers
strengths: Geathers drops with discipline in zone and can mirror backs/TEs in man from space-LB looks.
Geathers triggers downhill on run reads and uses active hands to get off perimeter blocks.
Geathers finishes open-field tackles with sound fundamentals sideline-to-sideline.
Geathers diagnoses quickly pre-snap and plays with contact courage for a 6-1.5 / 195 frame.
weaknesses: Geathers still needs mass to take on SEC guards consistently as more than a sub-package LB.
comparison: Geathers comps to Roquan Smith -- lean, space-capable off-ball LB who wins with trigger speed, coverage, and tackling (size-matched toward Geathers' 6-1.5 / 195 mold with fill-out room).
projection: Geathers projects as develop into the LB room, earn early special-teams and nickel-LB snaps, then compete for a starting WILL/space role -- starter upside as a coverage-capable modern linebacker.
schemeFit: Geathers fits White as a WILL/Star hybrid who covers and fits the run in space.
insiderNotes: Geathers drops with discipline in zone and mirrors backs/TEs from space-LB looks. Triggers downhill on run reads, gets off perimeter blocks, and finishes open-field tackles sideline-to-sideline.
